name: Card Payments
trigger: You want to take money without handing someone a card reader or emailing an invoice and waiting.
summary: Never stores card data. Payment method references only. All other payment capabilities build on this one.

requires.reason: Charge amounts are Money; floating point currency is a defect.
A stored payment method belongs to a known customer.

enhances.unlocks: a receipt is issued automatically the moment a charge succeeds
checkout takes payment inline rather than redirecting
payments attribute to a job as revenue against its margin

owns.name: PaymentMethod
owns.description: A reference to a payment method held by the provider. Card data never touches our database.

owns.name: Charge
owns.description: Append-only. A charge is a financial record; corrections are refunds, never edits.

privacy.retention_note: Financial records are exempt from deletion and are anonymised so the ledger stays intact.

publishes.name: payment.succeeded
publishes.description: The most widely consumed event in the catalog. Invoices, ledger, deposits, payouts, and job costing all key off it.

consumes.name: identity.user.deleted
consumes.reason: detach stored payment methods from the provider

exposes.name: charge
exposes.signature: charge(amount: Money, customer: CustomerRef, opts?: ChargeOptions): Promise<Charge>
exposes.description: Agent-callable but always requires approval, regardless of trust level, because it moves money.

exposes.name: stripeWebhook
exposes.description: Signature-verified. An unverified payload is rejected before parsing.

external.purpose: Card authorisation, capture, refunds, and stored payment methods.

credentials.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
credentials.description: Stripe secret API key for this environment.

credentials.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
credentials.description: Signing secret used to verify inbound webhooks.

slots.name: beforeCharge
slots.when: before a charge is submitted to the provider
slots.description: Client-specific fraud screening, spend limits, or rejection. Returning a rejection prevents the charge.

slots.name: afterCharge
slots.when: after a charge succeeds, before payment.succeeded is published

slots.name: receiptCustomization
slots.description: Client-specific receipt content beyond branding tokens.

smoke.name: test-mode charge succeeds
smoke.asserts: a charge against a Stripe test card succeeds and publishes payment.succeeded

smoke.name: webhook signature is verified
smoke.asserts: an unsigned or mis-signed webhook payload is rejected with 400 before parsing

smoke.name: no card data is persisted
smoke.asserts: no column in any owned table accepts a PAN, and the provider reference is opaque

contract.scenario: a user is deleted while holding a stored payment method
contract.asserts: the payment method is detached at the provider and the local record is removed

contract.scenario: a charge succeeds against an open invoice
contract.asserts: the invoice is marked paid exactly once, and a duplicate payment.succeeded delivery does not double-apply

templates.description: Binds manifest config and the credential environment schema. Values are read from the environment at runtime.
Mounts the package's webhook handler. Wiring only.
Slot stubs, written once and then owned by the client repository.
